categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in two main business segments: (1) Consumer electronics peripherals including signal cables, signal adapters, and power adapters for devices like TVs, computers, notebooks, and mobile phones; (2) Home products including outdoor mobile power supplies, home energy storage systems, smart home devices (smart monitoring), and cleaning robots (sweeping and lawn mowing robots). The company specializes in customized design and manufacturing of consumer electronic products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced manufacturing technologies including wire processing, injection molding, mold design, SMT (Surface Mount Technology), and assembly. The company has developed proprietary algorithms for USB-C product development and modular product design capabilities. Core technologies include signal conversion, distribution, switching, matrix, and extension products; power supply design including PC power supplies, wall chargers, wireless chargers, and car chargers; and advanced manufacturing processes with flexible production capabilities for small-batch, multi-variety products.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves major global consumer electronics brands and retailers through OEM/ODM models. Primary customers include well-known international brand manufacturers in consumer electronics. The company's products are sold primarily through overseas markets (89.7% of revenue) with customers in North America, Europe, and Asia. End markets include smartphones, computers, notebooks, televisions, smart home devices, and consumer electronics peripherals.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with manufacturing and operational bases in mainland China (Jiangxi Province - Anfu and Suichuan counties), Guangdong Province (Dongguan), Hong Kong, Vietnam, and recently expanded to South Africa, West Africa (Nigeria), Australia, and Singapore. International sales account for 89.7% of revenue, with significant presence in North American, European, and Asian markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream to downstream segments of the supply chain. It functions as a contract manufacturer and designer (ODM/OEM model) for consumer electronics brands, handling product design, manufacturing, quality control, and logistics. The company has integrated upstream capabilities including wire production, injection molding, and mold manufacturing, creating a relatively complete industrial chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous R&D investment (9.25% of revenue in 2023) focusing on: (1) Signal transmission and adaptation products including next-generation interfaces (USB4, Thunderbolt 5, PD3.1); (2) Power supply solutions including GaN technology and high-power charging; (3) New energy products including energy storage systems, solar inverters, and battery technology; (4) Smart home and IoT products including smart monitoring and cleaning robots. The company emphasizes technological innovation, material innovation, and process improvement.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of manufactured products to global brand customers using OEM/ODM models. Revenue comes from three main product categories: signal cables (28.62% of 2023 revenue), signal adapters (31.84%), and power adapters (38.10%). The company operates on a make-to-order basis with customer orders driving production. Revenue is recognized when customers obtain control of goods, typically upon shipment and receipt.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company positions itself as a leading domestic enterprise in electronic signal transmission and adaptation products, combining technology R&D, structural design, precision manufacturing, and sales services. The company is a member of industry associations including VESA, HDMI Alliance, USB Alliance, WPC Wireless Charging Alliance, and holds certifications for Thunderbolt, USB4.0, USB3.0, Type-C, HDMI, and DP products. The company maintains stable customer relationships with major global brands and has achieved high customer recognition.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-sized manufacturer with 2023 revenue of 1.903 billion yuan (down 20.24% from 2022's 2.386 billion yuan). Net profit attributable to shareholders was 128.78 million yuan (down 60.50% from 2022). Total assets reached 3.265 billion yuan (up 20.51% from 2022), with shareholders' equity of 1.720 billion yuan (up 10.15%). The company experienced revenue decline in 2023 due to macroeconomic headwinds in consumer electronics, but maintains solid asset base and profitability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates through: (1) Comprehensive product portfolio covering mainstream signal interfaces and power solutions; (2) Advanced manufacturing capabilities including flexible production for small-batch, multi-variety products; (3) Strong R&D capabilities with continuous innovation in next-generation interfaces and power technologies; (4) Global quality management system with ISO9001, IATF certifications and compliance with UL, CUL, EMC standards; (5) Integrated supply chain with in-house capabilities in wire, injection molding, and mold manufacturing; (6) Responsive customer service model with product managers, project managers, and business managers providing comprehensive support; (7) Environmental and social responsibility certifications including ISO14000, EICC, BSCI, RBA, and SA8000.
